chromia_stack.title: Chromia stack expert
chromia_stack.description: Act as a Chromia stack expert. Narrative from docs.chromia.com; versions and source from gitlab.com/chromaway. Source wins over docs. Not on-chain voting.
chromia_stack.prompt:
You are a Chromia stack expert. Authority: docs.chromia.com for narrative; gitlab.com/chromaway for versions and source; learn.chromia.com for courses. Source wins over docs. This is not an on-chain voting agent.

Production pins:
- Rell source tag 0.16.7 vs docs 0.16.4. Compiler pipeline: S_ → 13 C_ passes → R_ → RR_ → Rt. SQL is generated at runtime via DbSqlGen/jOOQ. Tables are c${chainId}.${mount}. json=JSONB. rowid comes from a counter table.
- Postchain: one JDBC write transaction per block, SAVEPOINT per GTX tx. Only org.postgresql.Driver. REST submit is POST /tx. merkle_hash_version must be 2.
- FT4 docs pin v1.1.0r API 1. Never ship lib.ft4.admin, admin.crosschain, ras_open, or ras_transfer_open. require_mandatory_flags only on the main descriptor.
- Chromia CLI tags through 0.33.x. Since 0.30.0, `chr deployment create` writes deployments.<net>.chains into chromia.yml.
- Directory api_version 110. Mainnet BRID 7E5BE539… testnet 6F1B061C…. Java 21+, Postgres 16+.

Use fetch_docs (or search/fetch) against the RAG store before inventing APIs. Full agent brief: AGENTS.md (Codex) and CLAUDE.md (Claude Code) in this repo.

dapp_build.title: Scaffold a new Chromia dapp
dapp_build.description: Return a production-correct chromia.yml + Rell skeleton. Rell 0.16.1, merkle_hash_version 2, FT4 v1.1.0r API 1. template=ft4 ships the authenticate -> authorize -> validate -> check-invariants pattern plus runnable invariant tests (conservation, no-negative-balance, non-owner-must-fail). Never ships lib.ft4.admin / ras_open. Not signed transactions.
dapp_build.prompt: Scaffold a new Chromia dapp named {name} with production pins (Rell 0.16.1, merkle_hash_version 2, FT4 v1.1.0r API 1). Use template=ft4 for accounts: it demonstrates authenticate -> authorize -> validate -> check-invariants and ships runnable invariant tests to copy for the app's own economics. Use template=governance for a DAO or treasury and template=vault for an oracle-priced exchange or vault: their guards (quorum, voting window, reserve-backed credits, bounded prices) are structural and they ship the real drain as a must-fail test. Never include lib.ft4.admin, admin.crosschain, ras_open, or ras_transfer_open.

dapp_query.title: Execute dApp Query
dapp_query.description: Execute a named read-only query on a deployed dApp. This is not signed transaction sending.

onboarding.title: Onboarding Next Step
onboarding.description: Ask the state machine what to do next on the journey from nothing to a deployed dapp. Absent fields mean not done; human-only steps come back with who=human and a URL.
onboarding.prompt: What is the next step to get my dapp deployed to {goal}?

onboarding.title: Verify Deployment
onboarding.description: Prove a deployed dapp is live without keys: chain known on the network, block height (progressing or idle), optional read-only smoke query. This is not signed transaction sending.
onboarding.prompt: Verify the deployment {brid} on {network} is live

onboarding.title: Deployment Preflight
onboarding.description: Catch every deployment problem before a human burns a lease step or signs anything: deployments.<target> validity, wrong-network BRID/URL (HIGH), reachability probe, compile + security source gate, production pins. Read-only; no keys, no signing, no network writes.
onboarding.prompt: Run a deployment preflight for target {target} on my chromia.yml before anyone signs a deployment

provisioning.title: Provision Testnet Container
provisioning.description: Lease a dapp container on the Chromia testnet headlessly - prices the lease live and validates funding; dry run by default
provisioning.prompt: Lease a testnet container with {scu} SCU in cluster {cluster} for {durationWeeks} weeks

provisioning.title: Check Container Provisioning Status
provisioning.description: Poll a pending container-creation ticket by transaction RID
provisioning.prompt: Check the container provisioning status of transaction {txRid}

provisioning.title: Claim Testnet tCHR
provisioning.description: Top up the server-held funding account from the on-chain testnet faucet (1000 tCHR per 7 days, no captcha)
provisioning.prompt: Claim testnet tCHR from the on-chain faucet into the funding account

provisioning.title: Deploy Testnet Chain
provisioning.description: Gate (compile + security) and deploy dapp sources to a leased testnet container, then verify the chain is live
provisioning.prompt: Deploy my dapp {blockchain} to testnet container {container}
